item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia launched a ballistic missile at Zelenskyy's hometown in central Ukraine and conducted airspace violations, while Ukrainian drones set a Russian cargo ship ablaze in the Gulf of Finland and hit another vessel in the Baltic Sea. Ukraine also struck the Kerch Bridge and reported a massive explosion on a street in Lviv. Estonia shut its border with Russia after a GRU-linked sabotage attack and explosions were reported near the Russian Baltic Fleet base in Kaliningrad Oblast. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Medics say Israeli ambulances are being impeded in the West Bank, delaying care for the wounded. In Gaza, children are struggling to obtain life-saving insulin amid the siege. The Israeli military warned that a strike on Iran could trigger a multi-front war. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Russian air strikes hit Aleppo, killing three children. Senior ISIS figures were killed in operations in Diyala and northeastern Iraq, while a new Shiite militia, Asa'ib Al-Jihad, announced its formation. Humanitarian conditions are worsening as charity kitchens in Khartoum close and displaced Sudanese, especially the elderly, face severe hardship. The national election has been postponed again, now set for February 2027, and a Sudanese official has accused Ethiopia and South Sudan of fueling regional instability. item.description:

Federal forces have quietly relaunched the previously failed Banooda operation, moving a major troop convoy, while Djibouti peacekeepers were killed in a clash with Hawadle militias at Beledweyne airport and later repelled the attackers. The United States has reversed its position and will fund UN military support in Somalia for another year, and it also reversed a prior decision by withdrawing funding for international military support.
